en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Hadeed, from Jameel, from one of our companions that,
‘Heasws said: ‘There is no Zakāt upon the gold dust. But rather it (Zakāt) is upon the Dinars and the Dirhams’.
en.sarwar: 9. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Hadid from Jamil from certain persons of our people who have said the following: “
Zakat is not due on gold. Zakat becomes due only on dinars and dirhams.”
